label: D1 up after unrewarded S1 (esp. a1 S1 u), down after rewarded S2; D2 rare-transition sign
terms: (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 1) * (prev_reward == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 0) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (state == 2) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 2) * (state == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 u") ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 1) * (prev_state == 2)
explanation: Raw reset gate r47: timing (low at D1 ~0.23, high at GO/D2 ~0.75) explains R^2 0.86; beyond timing, magnitude is driven by the last outcome x state. At D1 it rises after an unrewarded trial that reached S1 (+0.19, an extra +0.11 when that was a common a1->S1 trial, so a1 S1 u ~+0.31, a2 S1 u ~+0.2) and falls after a rewarded trial that reached S2 (-0.15); S1 rewarded and S2 unrewarded are near baseline. At GO it is slightly higher after any unrewarded trial (+0.065) and lower after S2 rewarded (-0.05). At D2 it depends on the just-made transition: rare a2->S1 lowers it (-0.20), rare a1->S2 raises it (+0.13), common transitions near baseline. All terms are observed at their step (no future/hidden cues). The trial before adds almost nothing (+0.02 dev). Test R^2 beyond timing 0.80 vs all-cue ceiling 0.87 (all observed 0.84).

issues: Minor: the D1 activation is higher on the episode's first trial (worst-fit windows at t0 show actual 0.67 against predicted 0.27). Adding (phase == D1) * (ep_trial == 0) raises test R^2 from 0.799 to 0.807, which is small but unmentioned.

Minor: at D1, runs of repeated unrewarded S1 trials (a2 S1R u, several in a row) are under-predicted, about 0.58 actual against 0.44 predicted in the worst windows. Adding a term for the trial two back as S1 unrewarded adds only +0.001 test R^2, so the accumulation does not generalize as a simple term.

Residual errors by phase and previous trial are all under 0.045 in absolute value (largest: D1 after a2 S1 r -0.043, GO after a1 S2 r -0.042, D2 after a2 S1 r +0.041). There is no large systematic class left.

The claims check out against the profile residuals. D1: a1 S1 u +0.31, a2 S1 u +0.20, S2 r -0.15. D2: rare a2->S1 -0.20, rare a1->S2 +0.14. GO effects are small, and dropping the two GO terms lowers test R^2 from 0.799 to 0.729. No future variables are used. The score of 0.80 is close to the observed-only additive ceiling of 0.84.
